## AI disclosure

Tick exactly one box. Pull requests from outside contributors are checked automatically, and a pull request written with AI help is flagged for a line by line review.

1. [ ] No AI tools were used to write this change
2. [ ] AI tools helped write this change and I have reviewed and tested every line myself

## Checklist

1. [ ] Every commit is signed and shows as Verified
2. [ ] All checks pass locally and in CI
3. [ ] The pull request does one thing
4. [ ] Tests cover the change, and a bug fix has a test that fails before it
5. [ ] No public interface, wire format, storage layout or hashing domain changes without an agreed issue or proposal
6. [ ] No change to finality or throughput, or benchmark results before and after are attached
7. [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is given above
8. [ ] No secrets, keys, seeds or personal data in the diff
9. [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and agree to license this work under Apache 2.0 and MIT
